punchline: On a list of ten, Tracy says one task can be worth more than the other nine put together, and it is usually the one people dodge.
thirty_sec: Brian Tracy wants five letters in front of your list before you start. A is a must with serious consequences, B a tadpole with mild ones, C is nice but optional, D can be delegated and E can be dropped. The rule is simple: never touch a B while an A is undone. Then start on A-1, the biggest, ugliest frog, and stay with it until it is finished.
